pages.text: In the $(item)Bomb Calorimeter$() a weighed sample burns in pure oxygen inside a steel bomb, under water. The heat q = m·ΔH_c warms the water by $(thing)ΔT = q/C$(). Size the sample so the rise is readable (1.5 to 3 K) and give it oxygen enough to burn it all: each burn writes a $(item)Thermochemical Data Card$() and gives Insight.
